Type: macrame fringe lumbar pillow
Use: back support and decoration on a sofa, bed or armchair; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, coastal, contemporary
Materials: woven cotton canvas, knotted macrame trim, tassel fringe
Colors: light dusty blue, cool pastel blue
Shape: rectangular lumbar, plain face, knotted bands with long fringe on both short sides, compact
Feel: airy, relaxed, soft
Goes with: white bedding, rattan, light wood, sandy neutrals; bohemian or coastal bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Macrame Fringe Lumbar Throw Pillow - 18 x 12 Inch, Blue
product.description: Imported This stylish modern throw pillow features a sky blue fabric and matching macramé fringe for a tasseled bohemian aesthetic that can set your space apart. 18"L x 12"W macramé fringe; hidden zipper closure Pillow cover and insert Spot clean only.
